name: Umbral-Transept
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in bioluminescent seas. Travelers navigate by magnetic pole anomalies and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
The air carries cold salt and iodine, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
There is money in titanium, medicinal compounds and uranium and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
